roles.founder_intent_steward: Close buildable obligations rather than stopping at an audit, but leave VEPMC and real-world founder gates untouched. A truthful system 9 transition advances the Foundry contract; a count-driven flip would betray it. Alfonso Lopez remains root constitutional authority.
roles.systems_architect: Keep separate evidence owners: foundry.completion reproduces the local deterministic context record, while the existing hosted workflow owns real OCI build and second-environment execution. Add no runtime, authority plane, builder permission, routing plane, or second completion system.
roles.adversarial_reviewer: A green check is not magic evidence. It counts only because run, job, step and source head match and the inspected script exits successfully only after immutable rebuild equality and six exact behavior comparisons. The inaccessible artifact remains a material objection to any stronger claim.
roles.operator_maintainer: Preserve exact run/job/artifact identifiers, expiration and archive digest; record 401/403/sign-in limits and cancelled overall CI job. Recovery rebuilds reviewed bytes, refuses tampered context, removes the disposable builder, and returns PARTIAL on drift rather than reusing stale success.
roles.evidence_welfare_guardian: Keep image_built=false in local evidence, SANDBOX_VERIFIED as the ceiling, negative results and dissent visible, and VEPMC at 0. Do not turn one restricted-rule capability into full GREG/organ portability or independent external verification. Five perspectives are self-review by one agent, not independent reviewers.

Flip state to improve the 50/55 count without satisfying acceptance.
Treat a restricted-rule fixture as full GREG, organ, or general-code packaging.
Treat one green job as the whole workflow or as VEPMC.
Hide a mount-induced test failure or relabel it as a code defect without diagnosis.
